prompt_used:
Create a minimalist tech blog cover image for Alici.AI.

Background: Pure black (#000000) with a single abstract fluid shape in teal (#4FD1C5). The shape should look like a flowing ribbon of light, smooth and organic, suggesting motion and digital creation. It flows from the upper right toward center-left, occupying approximately 30% of the frame. Soft glow around edges, no hard boundaries. A subtle constellation of small teal dots scattered near the ribbon, suggesting a network of AI-generated personas.

Typography:
- Main title: "AI INFLUENCERS" in extra-bold white (#FFFFFF) sans-serif typography (similar to Inter Black), very large and prominent
- Secondary: "Batch Production Guide 2026" in bold white, 50% size of main title
- Subtitle: "How to Create at Scale" in regular white at 70% opacity, 25% size
- Brand tag: "Officially on Alici.AI" in small regular white at 60% opacity, positioned at bottom

Text position: Left-center area, leaving right side for the fluid element.

Style: Ultra-minimalist, generous negative space (50%+ dark), clean typography hierarchy. Professional tech aesthetic. The fluid shape and text should feel balanced but not symmetrical.

Aspect ratio: 16:9
Resolution: 1920x1080
